name: experience-effectiveness-record-doc
title: Land the Experience Layer effectiveness-proof development record (decision-doc)
description: Record IN the Orchestrate repo (docs/requirements/decisions/) what the Experience Layer effectiveness-proof track built and the evidence it obtained. The execution PLAN was landed earlier (lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md, B-1480), but there is no in-repo record of the OUTCOME: the referential re-validation instrument, the forward A/B apparatus (learning_scan, signatureTag capture, A/B shadow-gate, learning_effectiveness), the signature_backfill command, and the learnability evidence. This story materializes a manual-source decision-doc via decision_doc_proposal + decision_doc_save into docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-effectiveness-record.md. It is documentation only: no source code, CLI, handler, core module, registry, or gate change. The detailed raw evidence (figures/CSVs/scripts) stays in the out-of-repo Work/lattice-Paper/ workspace and is referenced, not duplicated.
